messages:
lee: Quick heads-up — product is planning a staged rollout tomorrow. We need a small canary dashboard to compare A/B per-route latency and quality deltas.
divya: what's the signal set you want? p99 latency + token-level quality evals? 
lee: yes p50/p95/p99 latency, mean tokens, and a regression delta for eval_score (we already have eval_score emitted by offline evals; need online sample counts). Also need KV cache hit and avg batch sizes.
sam: runtime can emit: inference_latency_ms{quantile="p99"}, tokens_generated_total, kv_cache_hits, batch_size_avg. infra can emit node_gpu_util, node_mem_free, queue_length.
maria: +1 on rollout_id tag. If we don't have rollout_id on runtime traces it's painful to slice.
opsbot: deploy started: rollout r-123 to 5% traffic (user=jordan) :rocket:
jordan: tagging question — can we also slice by customer_tier and route? enterprise customers need tighter SLOs.
divya: yes we should include labels: rollout_id, route, model_variant, customer_tier, pod_id. prom names proposal:
- inference_latency_ms_bucket (histogram)
- tokens_generated_total
- inference_eval_score_sum and inference_eval_score_count (to compute avg)
Example promql for p99 per variant:
  histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(inference_latency_ms_bucket{rollout_id="r-123"}[5m])) by (le, model_variant))
lee: For dashboard panels: 1) traffic split by model_variant, 2) delta heatmap: (new-old)/old for eval_score by route, 3) latency waterfall: p50/p95/p99 by variant, 4) resource pressure correlated lines (gpu_util, queue_length).
sam: alerting: fire if eval_score delta < -0.02 for 10 minutes with >= 1k samples, or p99 latency increases > 50ms for 5 minutes.
maria: can we auto-populate the canary panel when rollout is created in the console? we can emit a webhook with rollout_id and route meta.
lee: great — eng-console to add webhook; eng-runtime to ensure labels. divya can you own the promql panels? 
divya: I can draft panels today, will post jsonnet snippets. Also need a small sampling pipeline to capture eval samples (10% of requests) and ship to quality service.
lee: thanks. next steps: eng-runtime add labels rollout_id/customer_tier/model_variant; eng-infra ensure node metrics are tagged with pod_id & shard; eng-console add rollout webhook. meet 11:30 if needed.
maria: ack.
sam: ack, will add a PR for metrics and a test harness.
opsbot: deploy success: canary r-123 at 5% stable.
